warnings: Axes: x = 1-4 (4.00 each); y = A, B, C, D (4.00 each) — an L-shaped plan: row D exists only under bay 3-4. Origin A1.

Three lines are not dimensioned anywhere on the S sheets and were measured by proportion against the grid (§4 span amendment), each flagged: the two roof ridges (x 2.00 and 10.00, also the centres of the printed eave-to-eave widths) and the right roof's gable edge below D (y 13.00).

x 1.90 (1'', beam B1) and 2.00 (1''', ridge) are different lines 0.10 apart, as in sibling house 52 where the ridge sat on the B1 line; here the S-03 dimension puts B1 at 1.90 while the roof is symmetric about 2.00. Kept apart, the ridge flagged as scaled.
The F2 detail on S-05 is drawn rotated 90°: building 1.30 along x × 1.00 along y, piles on the y centreline C''' (9.85).
Architectural sheets were not dimension-swept (op04 time budget for this batch) — z_levels holds only the ground datum printed on the S sheets.
